1.text: Muririmbire Uwiteka indirimbo nshya,Mwa bari mu isi mwese mwe,Muririmbire Uwiteka.

2.text: Muririmbire Uwiteka muhimbaze izina rye,Mwerekane agakiza ke uko bukeye.

3.text: Mwogeze icyubahiro cye mu mahanga,Imirimo itangaza yakoze muyogeze mu mahanga yose.

4.text: Kuko Uwiteka akomeye akwiriye gushimwa cyane,Kandi ateye ubwoba, arusha ibigirwamana byose.

5.text: Kuko ibigirwamana by'amahanga byose ari ubusa,Ariko Uwiteka ni we waremye ijuru.

6.text: Icyubahiro no gukomera biri imbere ye,Imbaraga n'ubwiza biri ahera he.

7.text: Mwa miryango y'amahanga mwe, mwāturire Uwiteka,Mwāturire Uwiteka ko afite icyubahiro n'imbaraga.

8.text: Mwāturire Uwiteka ko izina rye rifite icyubahiro,Muze mu bikari bye muzanye ituro.

9.text: Musenge Uwiteka mwambaye ibyera,Mwa bari mu isi mwese mwe,Muhindire umushyitsi imbere ye.

10.text: Muvugire mu mahanga muti“Uwiteka ari ku ngoma.”Kandi isi irakomeye ntibasha kunyeganyega,Azacira amahanga imanza zitabera.

11.text: Ijuru rinezerwe, isi yishime,Inyanja ihōrerane n'ibiyuzuye,

12.text: Ikigarama cyishimane n'ibikirimo byose,Ni bwo ibiti byo mu ishyamba bizaririmbishwa n'ibyishimo.

13.text: Imbere y'Uwiteka kuko agiye kuza,Agiye kuza agacira abari mu isi imanza,Azacira abari mu isi imanza zitabera,Azacira amahanga imanza zihwanye n'umurava we.
